title: Debug: Even or Odd
description:
This script should report whether `payload.n` is even, but it throws on every input.

Find the bug and fix it so the output is `{ "n": <n>, "even": true | false }`.

**Hint:** in DataWeave, `==` binds tighter than `mod`.
starterCode:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{
  n: payload.n,
  even: payload.n mod 2 == 0
}
solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{
  n: payload.n,
  even: (payload.n mod 2) == 0
}
hints: Read the error: which arguments did `mod` receive?

examples.explanation: 4 mod 2 is 0, so it is even.

title: Debug: Adults Only
description:
Return the names of everyone who is **18 or older**. The script runs, but someone who is exactly 18 is left out.

Fix the filter.
hints: Who should be included at exactly 18?

title: Debug: Order Total with Missing Prices
description:
Sum `price` across `payload.items`. Some items have no price yet and should count as `0`, but the script fails as soon as one is missing.

Output `{ "total": <number> }`.
hints: What is `item.price` when the key is absent?

examples.explanation: The middle item has no price, so the total is 15.

title: Debug: Shout the Names
description:
Return every name in `payload.names` in upper case. The script throws because `upper` expects a single String, and it is given the whole array.

Output an array of upper-case names.
hints: What type does `upper` take, and what type is `payload.names`?

title: Debug: Count the Failed Jobs
description:
Count how many entries in `payload` have `status` equal to `"FAILED"`. The reduce has no starting value, so its first accumulator is the first job object, not a number.

Output `{ "failed": <count> }`.
hints: What is `acc` on the first call when it has no default?
Give the accumulator a starting value.

title: Debug: The Type Field
description:
Map `payload.kind` to an output field named `type`. The script fails to compile because `type` is a reserved word in DataWeave.

Output `{ "type": <kind> }`.

examples.explanation: The key is written as a quoted string.
